mapper.select: CREATE TABLE _ind_${code}_temporal ( crmp_llave varchar(32) NOT NULL, nrmp_nivel int, crmp_cuenta character varying(32) NOT NULL, drmp_fecha timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, nrmp_ano int, nrmp_mes int, nrmp_dia int, nrmp_hora int, nrmp_minuto int, nrmp_cantidad int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, nrmp_porcentaje NUMERIC(9,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_saldoanterior NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_positivo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_negativo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_valor NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, citm_estado varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A'::character varying, CONSTRAINT pk_ind_${code}_temporal PRIMARY KEY (crmp_llave) );

CREATE TABLE _ind_${code}_puntual ( crmp_llave varchar(32) NOT NULL, nrmp_nivel int, crmp_cuenta character varying(32) NOT NULL, drmp_fecha timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, nrmp_ano int, nrmp_mes int, nrmp_dia int, nrmp_hora int, nrmp_minuto int, nrmp_cantidad int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, nrmp_porcentaje NUMERIC(9,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_saldoanterior NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_positivo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_negativo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mrmp_valor NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, crmp_estado varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A'::character varying, CONSTRAINT pk_ind_${code}_puntual PRIMARY KEY (crmp_llave) );

CREATE TABLE _ind_${code}_comprobante ( ccmp_llave varchar(32) NOT NULL, ccmp_hecho character varying(32) NOT NULL, ccmp_formato character varying(32), ccmp_concepto character varying(200) NOT NULL, dcmp_fecha timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, ncmp_ano int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ncmp_mes int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ncmp_dia int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ncmp_hora int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ncmp_minuto int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mcmp_valor NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mcmp_positivo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mcmp_negativo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ccmp_plantilla character varying(32), ccmp_plantilla_nombre character varying(32), ccmp_documento character varying(32), ccmp_documento_nombre character varying(32), ccmp_estado varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A'::character varying, CONSTRAINT pk_ind_comprobante_${code} PRIMARY KEY (ccmp_llave) );

CREATE TABLE _ind_${code}_registro ( creg_llave varchar(32) NOT NULL, creg_comprobante character varying(32) NOT NULL, creg_cuenta character varying(32) NOT NULL, creg_descripcion character varying(200) NOT NULL, dreg_fecha timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, mreg_valor NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mreg_positivo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, mreg_negativo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, creg_estado varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A'::character varying, CONSTRAINT pk_ind_registro_${code} PRIMARY KEY (creg_llave) );

CREATE TABLE _ind_${code}_acumulador ( cacm_llave varchar(32) NOT NULL, cacm_registro character varying(32) NOT NULL, dacm_fecha timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, macm_valor NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, macm_positivo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, macm_negativo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, macm_saldoanterior NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, macm_saldonuevo NUMERIC(18,6) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cacm_estado varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A'::character varying, CONSTRAINT pk_ind_acumulador_${code} PRIMARY KEY (cacm_llave) );

CREATE TABLE _ind_${code}_auxiliar ( caux_llave varchar(32) NOT NULL, caux_registro character varying(32) NOT NULL, caux_dimension character varying(32) NOT NULL, caux_valor character varying(200) NOT NULL, caux_estado varchar(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A'::character varying, CONSTRAINT pk_ind_auxiliar_${code} PRIMARY KEY (caux_llave) );
